root.label: American Airlines says it will end involuntary bumping

events.label: American Airlines says it will end involuntary bumping

slots.name: bumping policy status
slots.sentence: “We’ve improved technology and improved process. And now I think we feel we’re to the point where we do not take an “involuntary denied” boarding,”

slots.name: bumping reduction
slots.sentence: The airline has slashed its rate of involuntary bumping since the start of the year, reducing those situations by 55% in the second quarter from a year earlier, and 85% in the third quarter.

slots.name: compensation cap
slots.sentence: Airlines have to pay as much as $2,150 when bumped passengers face lengthy delays.
